artworks.title: Christ before Caiphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a narrative scene set in an ancient cityscape. The drawing depicts a gathering of figures, with one individual, dressed in elaborate robes, standing elevated above others at what appears to be the entrance to a building. The surrounding figures, dressed in clothing suggesting a historic period, appear to be engaged in a discussion or confrontation. The background shows an architectural setting with tall buildings, a starry sky, and a few figures holding long staffs or torches. The setting and style of the drawing is suggestive of a medieval or Renaissance period. Fine lines and shading are used to create depth and texture, typical of engravings of this period.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval court scene. The central figure is seated on a throne beneath an ornate archway in a detailed architectural setting. Surrounding the central figure are figures dressed in period attire, appearing engaged in a discussion or audience. The background includes towering buildings with spires in a medieval city setting. The drawing utilizes hatching and cross-hatching techniques to add depth and texture, emphasizing the opulence of the throne and garments. The monochromatic composition showcases intricate line work capturing a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Flagellation of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a historical scene with an individual tied to a column and surrounded by other figures. The background features buildings with arched windows and intricate details. The foreground is dominated by the central column. The surrounding figures are in different actions and attire, suggesting an event. The composition is characterized by detailed line work and precision, emphasizing textures and expressions. The style suggests influences from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene set in a medieval or Renaissance urban environment. The composition centers around a figure who is seated and distressed, surrounded by several other figures engaged in various actions. Some are holding weapons and others are pointing or gesturing animatedly. The environment features arches and stone buildings with detailed brickwork, indicating an architectural style of the period. In the background, there are more buildings, including a church with a steeple, suggesting the setting may be in a city square or similar public space. The drawing shows intricate line work and hatching to create depth and texture in the scene.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a group of people surrounding a building with an ornate facade and stairs, where a figure draped in a cloth and wearing a thorny crown is displayed. The scene is highly detailed with intricate lines and hatching, creating depth and texture throughout the composition. The architectural elements include a building with large arched windows and ornate detailing, as well as medieval-style towers in the background. The figures below show varied expressions and gestures, with some holding wooden beams and others pointing or reaching out.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with a castle, a group of people, a large wooden cross, rugged mountainous terrain in the background, and figures in historical dress engaging in various activities. The drawing features intricate details in the stonework of the castle, the clothing of the figures, the facial expressions, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with three crucified figures in the center, surrounded by onlookers. Two figures are on each side of the central figure, attached to crosses. Below the crosses, various figures are depicted in detailed attire. The background shows a dark, cloudy sky with a bright sun shining down. The drawing features intricate line work and fine hatching emphasizing the dramatic tone and depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Burial of Christ
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people surrounding a central figure lying in a sarcophagus. The central figure is reclining with a tilted head and closed eyes, showcasing long hair and a bearded face, wearing a simple cloth that covers the lower part of the body. Surrounding this figure are multiple individuals in various positions, some standing, some kneeling or bending forward, and some embraced or leaning against others. Their facial expressions are solemn, and many have their heads covered with cloaks or shawls. The clothing of the people varies, with most wearing robes and tunics. Among the figures, one woman is seen on the right side, sitting or kneeling next to the central figure with a thoughtful expression. Some individuals in the background appear to stand in meditative or mournful gestures. The setting is rocky, with an arched entrance visible on the left, suggesting a cave or tomb-like environment. Nearby objects include a small, ornate container on the ground near the sarcophagus and what seems to be a crown of thorns. The background features craggy rock formations and archways.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: The illustration features multiple figures. In the center, a man in Renaissance armor stands confidently holding a sword and staff. Other figures, possibly soldiers, are depicted around him in various states. An angelic figure sits on a rock, gesturing towards a central ascending figure holding a flag and staff. Two women stand in the background. The scene includes a rocky archway and detailed surroundings.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.description: The image shows a person in robes, with one hand raised and fingers extended, while the other hand holds a spherical object. The person has a beard, mustache, a prominent nose, and long, curly hair. They are depicted with eyes looking to the side. A halo surrounds their head, emitting light beams. The background has lines echoing the halo's light. At the bottom, there is a block of Latin text against a plain background.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a seated position with his body slightly turned to the left while he looks upward. His facial features include a full beard and curly hair. He is wearing a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment. His hands are resting, with one hand laid over the other across his lap. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with rocks, hills, and a distant building or castle against a cloudy sky. The style of the image is highly detailed, resembling a classical engraving. Beneath the image, there is a Latin inscription and some decorative linework.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a man from slightly above the waist up, seated and turned to the side. His head is in profile showing his facial features. He has curly hair and a prominent nose. He wears a loose-fitting garment covering his shoulders and arms. In his left hand, he holds an open book close to his chest, and in his right hand, a long staff with a spear-like tip. The background shows a rocky landscape with vegetation, a body of water in the distance, possible islands or distant land, and a sky with a flock of birds.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows an older man leaning against a rock with his upper body and arms visible. He is bald with a fringe of curling hair and has closed eyes, a furrowed brow, and prominent facial features. He wears a loose-fitting robe and holds a long staff in his left hand. An open book lies in front of him. The background shows a rocky landscape with mountains, a tree with branches overhead, and an open sky. At the bottom, there is a decorative border with Latin text.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a person shown from the waist up. The person is seated, leaning forward with their head tilted downward. They have a large mustache and long, curly gray hair. The individual is wearing a robe and their hands are clasped together on their lap. The background is detailed with curvaceous lines and there is Latin text in the lower portion of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Jude Thaddeus
artworks.description: In the image, the upper half of a person's body is portrayed. They are seated, turned slightly to the right with their head tilted upwards and left. Features include a large nose, long curly beard, and hair falling to the nape of the neck. The person wears loose, draped clothing resembling a robe or tunic with layered folds. The right hand holds a closed book, and the left hand is raised with extended fingers. The background is textured, depicting mountains, foliage, and clouds. At the bottom are the words "CARNIS RESVRRECTIONEM" and a decorative flourish.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a relaxed position, facing slightly to his left. He has a round face with pronounced eyebrows and a full beard, while his hair appears short and wavy. He is dressed in a draped garment that covers his body, and he is holding a large sword upright in his left hand, with his right hand resting on a closed book. In the background, there are rocky cliffs and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a half-length portrait. The man is turned slightly to the side, with his face looking directly at the viewer. He has a long beard and strong stare, with long wavy hair flowing down to his shoulders. He wears a loose garment with wide sleeves and holds an object against his body, possibly a sword. The background features textured surfaces with abstract lines resembling rocky cliffs, sparse vegetation, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows an older man kneeling and facing slightly upwards. His head is turned towards the left, and his hands are clasped together in front of him. He has a prominent forehead, flowing beard, receding hairline, short curly hair, and is dressed in long, flowing robes. In front of him lies a book with a cross on its cover, and a set of large keys are placed atop the book, each positioned just below his hands. The background consists of a cave-like setting with textured walls, and there are a few branches or leaves visible at the top. The lower portion of the image contains Latin text.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated from the waist up. He is angled slightly away from the viewer, resting his head on one hand and leaning on the other arm. The man has a deeply lined face, a large beard, curly hair, and appears focused on something outside the frame. He wears flowing garments and a book is under his arm. In the background, there are rugged, mountainous rock formations. Ornate text frames the image at the bottom.

artworks.title: Saint James Major
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body view of a seated person with their right hand resting on their head. The person has a distinct face with strong lines and deep-set eyes, and their hair is long, curly, and flows onto their shoulders. They are wearing a robe with loose, draped sleeves and a cape or cloak with a scallop shell attached. A large, broad-brimmed hat with similar shells and a cross is hanging off their back. In their left hand, they are holding a long staff or stick. The background features a rocky landscape with a large tree on the right side. At the bottom of the image, there is text written in Latin.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper half including the head, torso, and hands. The individual is seated, facing slightly to the left with an attentive expression. They have curly hair cascading around the shoulders. The clothing is draped and flowing. The right hand is resting on the chest, and the left hand is holding a cup. In the background, there are rocky formations and a sky with swirling clouds. A closed book is placed beside them.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated from the waist up. His face is round with distinguished features, his hair is thin and curly, and he is wearing a robe. In his left hand, he holds a staff that ends in a cross, while his right hand rests on his chest. An open book is in front of him. The background shows a detailed landscape with hills and distant buildings. The text below the image reads, “Descendit ad inferna, tertia die resurrexit a mortuis.”

artworks.title: Euterpe
artworks.description: The image shows a woman playing a flute. She is seated with her head slightly turned to the right and tilted downward, focusing on the flute. She has serene and focused facial features with delicate eyes and mouth. Her hair is styled in a bun at the crown of her head. She wears a flowing garment with a broad neckline and long sleeves. Her feet are bare, and she sits on a textured fabric or cushion. Two closed books are at her feet, and a horn-like instrument is beside her. The background has a detailed pattern.

artworks.title: Erato
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned in a relaxed posture, slightly turned to her right, holding a sphere in her right hand. Her facial features are delicate and serene, with closed eyes and a gentle expression. Her hair is styled in an elegant manner, swept back and possibly held in place with decorative elements. She is wearing a classical garment with flowing folds and long sleeves, which drapes gracefully around her body. She holds a measuring compass in her left hand, resting on her lap. In the background, there is a textured pattern that resembles stone or a carved surface. At her feet is a set square.
